What I do

End-to-end support for F&B brands.

I connect the creative side of a brand with the commercial side—so the work looks good, communicates clearly and makes business sense.

01 / BRAND IDENTITY

Make your brand memorable.

Brand strategy, naming, logos, colours, typography, brand kits and visual systems that create a consistent identity.

02 / CONCEPT DEVELOPMENT

Turn ideas into experiences.

Practical café, restaurant, bakery and cloud-kitchen concepts shaped around audience, market and business potential.

03 / MENU & FOOD INNOVATION

Make the offer easier to choose.

Menu planning, product presentation, food tasting, costing direction, standardisation and customer-facing communication.

04 / MARKETING & PRINT

Make every touchpoint work.

Packaging, labels, stickers, menus, campaigns, social media creatives, signage and promotional material.

05 / BUSINESS CONSULTING

Find where money is leaking.

Support around food cost, menu profitability, customer experience, positioning and business improvement.

06 / LAUNCH SUPPORT

Build with clarity from day one.

Support for new cafés, restaurants, bakeries, cloud kitchens and hospitality concepts from planning to launch.
